--- P9-asyncio: asyncio.gather over the sync call_tool

import asyncio, time
t = time.time()
async def one(i):
    return call_tool("lookup", id=i)
async def main():
    return await asyncio.gather(*[one(i) for i in [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]])
asyncio.run(main())
print(int((time.time() - t) * 1000))
